Satellite name KickSat
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status Reentry 2014-05-15. Was semi-operational. Sent beacons, but could not receive commands and failed to deploy Sprites due to timer reset.
Launched 2014-04-18
NORAD ID 39685
Deployer P-POD (Poly-Picosatellite Orbital Deployer)

Entity name Cornell University
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters US
Oneliner

Carry and deploy 104 Sprite chipsats.
Description

Carry and deploy 200 Sprites. A 1U avionics bus will provide power, communications, and command and data handling functions. A 2U deployer has been developed to house the Sprites. 104 Sprites will be stacked atop a spring-loaded pusher and secured by a nichrome burn wire system.

Failure cause Sent beacons, but could not receive commands and failed to deploy Sprites due to timer reset.
